claims.claim: CM 2.0.0 exposes 21 rich object records and a 254-slot catalogue-control registry.
claims.limitations: Catalogue-control slots are not equivalent to rich records or verified transcriptions.

claims.claim: Cypro-Minoan native data can be exposed through Aegean Epigraphy Interchange v0.1 without merging native schemas with Linear A.
claims.limitations: Interoperability does not imply sign, segmentation, or phonetic equivalence.

claims.claim: Unicode, published signaries, and project sign identity remain separate authority layers.
No decipherment or phonetic assignment may be promoted from graphic similarity or historical relationship alone.
claims.limitations: Does not adjudicate external decipherment proposals.

claims.claim: Full-corpus statistical conclusions remain blocked while sign-sequence/occurrence coverage is sparse.
claims.limitations: Descriptive tests on explicitly scoped subsets remain possible.
